verdict.rationale: three.js links to a first-party "three.js editor" at threejs.org/editor, so the project ships its own visual editor. The evidence is only a bare link, though, and the rest of the pack frames three.js as a code-first library driven through its JavaScript API, not editor-first. TransformControls is a developer building block and the devtools extension is an adjacent debugging aid, so neither earns credit here. Missing for 10: any documentation of the editor's viewport, inspector, or prefab/scene-composition features; evidence that it is a primary level-building workflow; independent or hands-on corroboration of the editor's capability.
